about_the_game:
💼 Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not.

Step into the polished shoes of Ted Grady, one of the last remaining liftboys in a world that no longer cares about the art of vertical transportation. Your job? Carry luggage and deal with whatever chaos the hotel throws your way. Sounds simple, right? Think again.

🔹 Deliver luggage… if physics lets you.
Every suitcase has a destination, but between elevators, impatient guests, and unexpected obstacles, getting them there is an entirely different challenge.

🔹 Meet guests, fulfill requests… some more questionable than others.
From VIPs with unreasonable demands to guests who seem a little too comfortable in the hotel, your shift is never boring.

🔹 Master the elevator.
You control the hotel’s lifeline—the elevator. Time it wrong, and guests get impatient. Overload it, and physics will make you regret it.

🔹 Survive the shift.
In a job where no one tips, the real challenge is making it through the day.

Ted ask for this game to be made. And now that it exists, he’ll make sure it’s done right.

🧍‍♂️ Meet Ted

In the game, Ted is a young hotel liftboy with a dream:
👉 Earn $1,000,000 and finally buy his own hotel. 🏨💸

But let’s be honest — bellhop tips won’t get him there.
So yes... his journey might get a little morally flexible. 😅

Expect an adventure full of risky requests, shady side-jobs,
and ethically questionable opportunities. 🔍💼

Whether Ted accepts them (or not)?
That’s up to you. 🎮

You’ll guide him by balancing:
📊 Risk
🧭 Morality
💵 Reward

Because being a liftboy might be a simple job...

But getting out? That’s where things get complicated. 🛗

🔔 Step in, press the button… and good luck.

name: The Liftboy

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game is controlled using a keyboard and mouse. Gamepads are currently not supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Octa-core Intel or AMD processor, 3 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX Series (e.g., RTX 3060 or higher) or AMD Radeon RX 6000 Series (e.g., RX 6800 or higher)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game is controlled using a keyboard and mouse. Gamepads are currently not supported.

short_description: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. Carry luggage, serve guests, and survive the chaos of hotel life. From physics-driven suitcase disasters to questionable VIP requests, this isn’t just a job—it’s a game. And Ted Grady? He’s the last of his kind.
